title: Separate verification, approval, and acceptance boundaries across workctl and wiki (P05)
acceptance_criteria: Bind approvals to exact action, source revisions, hashes, and authority
CLI actor strings cannot substitute for human authentication
Remove unconditional human review pass from validator registry
Work acceptance requires independent verification and genuine human decision
description: Enforce strict separation between implementer verification, independent review, and human acceptance authority (P05).

spec_decisions.decision: Acceptance requires a named authority and an independent review receipt; a live claim does not authorise it
spec_decisions.decided_by: operator, decision 2A of the 2026-09-12 workspace review
spec_decisions.mechanism: bin/workctl accept requires --authority "<who decided, and on what basis>" and an independent-review*.json receipt in the evidence target. The previous rule required a live mutating claim, which cannot exist for an item in REVIEW: claims are created in READY and REVIEW->READY is not a legal transition, so the terminal state was unreachable.
spec_decisions.evidence: tools/workspace/workctl.mjs accept path; tools/workspace/workctl.test.mjs; AGENTS.md shared contracts
